effect.ibarnorigins.soul_fire_effect.des: Ka whakawhiwhia ki te kākahu whakamate me te tiaki e takahi ana i te kino i roto i te wā. Mēnā ka whakawhiwhia e tētahi Soul Sorcerer, ka whakawhiwhia he whiu ōrau e hāngai ana ki te hauora tino nui o te ūnga.
effect.ibarnorigins.casting_soul_firebal: Ko te Pūoro ahi o te Wairua
Ko te āheinga o te pōro ahi o ngā Kaitoi Wairua. Ka pupuhi i tētahi pōro ahi wairua i runga i te whakataunga pānga.
effect.ibarnorigins.soul_fire_strength_e: Ka whakapiki ake i te kino o te tata ki te 50% i te taumata 1 me te 100% i te taumata 2.
effect.ibarnorigins.fire_weakness_effect: Ka whakanuia te kino mai i ngā pūtake ahi ki te 100%.
effect.ibarnorigins.inflation_effect.des: Ka meinga e te Ghaster kia whakanuia.
effect.ibarnorigins.grant_soul_mage_attr: Whakawhiwhia ngā Āhuahira o te Kaitoi Wairua
effect.ibarnorigins.revoke_soul_mage_att: Whakakahoretia ngā Āhuahira o te Kaitohutohu Wairua
effect.ibarnorigins.grant_sand_person_at: Ngā Āhuahira Tangata o Grant Sand
entity.ibarnorigins.soul_fire_ball: Ko te Ball Fire Ball wairua
death.attack.ibarnorigins.soul_burn.play: I tahuna te wairua o te %1$s i a ia e ngana ana ki te rere i te %2$s
death.attack.ibarnorigins.soulBlast: %1$s i whakakahoretia e te pūngao wairua wānanga
death.attack.ibarnorigins.soulBlast.play: %1$s i whakakahoretia e te pūngao wairua wānanga i a ia e ngana ana ki te mawhiti %2$s
origin.ibarnorigins.ghaster.name: Ko te Ghaster
origin.ibarnorigins.ghaster.description: Ko ngā uri tawhiti o ngā Ghasts i whakaorangia mai i te Nether, ā, he tangata ake rātou nā te roa o tō rātou whakapā atu ki te Overworld.
origin.ibarnorigins.sandman.name: Te tangata onepu
origin.ibarnorigins.sandman.description: Ko te iwi onepu te iwi onepu e noho ana i roto i te onepu.
origin.ibarnorigins.soul_wizard.name: He Kaitoi Wairua
origin.ibarnorigins.soul_wizard.descript: He iwi iti o te tangata e āhei ana ki te whakawhiti i tō rātou pūngao wairua.
origin.ibarnorigins.wither_phantom.name: Ko te Wraith Wither
origin.ibarnorigins.wither_phantom.descr: He āhua ora, he āhua mate, he mea whakakotahi, he mea whakaranu tonu ki ngā mana ngaro i te mutunga o te whakakotahitanga ki ngā matū ngaro.
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterexhaust.name: He ngoikore te tinana
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterexhaust.descri: Ahakoa kua pai ake tō whakatikatika ki te Overworld, he ngoikore tō tinana, he puhoi ake te kohatu maina, he 25% te iti iho o te kino me te tere o te ngenge.
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterfireball.name: Te whakatakotoranga o te Poari ahi
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterfireball.descr: Ahakoa i mahue koe ki te Overworld, kua mau tonu i a koe te āheinga pōro ahi nui o ō tūpuna, tae noa ki tētahi taumata.
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterinflate.name: Te whakaputanga o te moni
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterinflate.descri: Mā te peke i te wā e hīkoi ana koe, ka pupuhi koe, ka ngaru hoki mō te wā poto.
power.ibarnorigins.ki_immunity.name: Ki Te Whakaaetanga
power.ibarnorigins.ki_immunity.descripti: He kaha tō ātete ki te kino o te makutu.
power.ibarnorigins.kiblast.name: Ko te Ball Fire Ball wairua
power.ibarnorigins.kiblast.description: Whakatikahia he pōro ahi motuhake e tahu ana i te wairua e piki ake ana i te kaha ka piki ake to taumata wheako (he tino nui i te taumata 100).
power.ibarnorigins.sandman_attributes.de: He iti ake te kino i te tū i runga i ngā kōpae onepu engari he 50% noa iho te kino i runga i tētahi mea ehara i te onepu. I tua atu, ka whanau tonu koe i te koraha.
power.ibarnorigins.sandman_sandbury.name: Te Hoko i te onepu
power.ibarnorigins.sandman_sandbury.desc: Ka taea e koe te keri i a koe i roto i te onepu. I a koe e tanumia ana, e kore koe e kitea.
power.ibarnorigins.sandman_shovel_damage: Tangohia 150% atu kino mai i ngā kōpae.
power.ibarnorigins.soul_speed.name: Wairua tere
power.ibarnorigins.soul_speed.descriptio: Ko te pūngao wairua i roto i te onepu wairua me te oneone wairua e āhei ai koe ki te tere haere.
power.ibarnorigins.soulfire_strength.nam: Te Mana ahi o te Wairua
power.ibarnorigins.soulfire_strength.des: Whakawhiwhia he 50% atu te nui o te kino i a koe e tū ana i te taha o ngā puna ahi wairua, e pupuri ana rānei i ō rātou taonga. Hei taapiri, ko te tu tika i roto i te ahi wairua ka whakanui i nga whakaeke me te 100% te whiu taapiri me te 50% te whiu o te pupuhi ahi wairua.
power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_fireweakness: Ahakoa e pai ana koe i te taha o te ahi o te wairua, he kaha te pānga o te ahi e mura tonu ana mai i nga rama me nga ahi puni ki a koe. Na reira, ka whiwhi anō koe i te 100% atu kino mai i te ahi, ā, ka matapo i te wa e whiwhi ana koe i te kino ahi.
power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_piglinfear.d: Ko te mura o te wairua taketake e mura ana i roto i a koe e whakaaweawe ana i te wehi ki nga Piglin katoa engari ko nga Piglin tino maia.
power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_vegetarian.n: Ko te Kai Kararehe e pai ana
power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_vegetarian.d: Kāore te kikokiko i te nui o te pūngao wairua e rite ana ki ngā huawhenua. I konei kāore te kai i te ora mō te wā roa engari ka hoatu e ngā huawhenua he wheako i runga i te kai i runga anō i te āhua o te whakakii i a rātou.
power.ibarnorigins.witherskull.name: Ko te Whero Whero Whero
power.ibarnorigins.witherskull.descripti: Whakamahia ngā mana o te hunga mate-kore, me te whakapā mai i ngā matenga maroke e rapu ana i ō hoariri.
power.ibarnorigins.wp_item_prevention.de: E kore e taea e koe te mau i tetahi whakangungu teitei atu i te whakangungu rino.
power.ibarnorigins.wpairswim.name: Te rerenga
power.ibarnorigins.wpairswim.description: He tino māmā tō tinana, ā, ka taea e koe te kaukau i roto i te hau.
power.ibarnorigins.wphealth.name: Te ngoikore
power.ibarnorigins.wphealth.description: Nā tō whakakotahitanga, ka pōhēhē tō tinana (5 ngā ngākau) ā, kāore e taea e koe te whakawātea i te nui o ngā pakaru ā-roto.
power.ibarnorigins.wphit.name: He Whakamate Whakamate
power.ibarnorigins.wphit.description: Mā ia whiu e whakawhiwhia ai e koe te pānga o te mate ki ō hoariri.
